Rank estimate from the FID trace

dot-rank_fid.Rd

Rank estimate from the FID trace

Usage

.rank_fid(fid, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

fid

List with numeric rt and intensity of equal length: the FID resampled onto the window's scans (see .extract_fid_window()).

call

Call environment for errors.

Value

Integer; the number of distinct peaks, or NA when fewer than 5 non-missing points are available. 0 for a flat, monotone or noise-only trace.

Details

Missing values are filled by linear interpolation. A local maximum counts when its prominence is at least moosaic.peak_min_height_snr times the noise and at least 5% of the trace range. Noise comes from third differences, which remove smooth peak structure. Unresolved shoulders are not visible to this method.
